name: Idol Yukiho no Godwan-chan Panic!
original_name: アイドル雪歩のゴッドワンちゃんパニック！
source:
Yukiho is fleeing in terror from dogs like usual,
but today a special god dog chases her down.
"I will grant you one wish," says the god dog.
She makes her wish, and in a brilliant flash he's gone!
Along with her panties!
Yukiho goes home with nothing under her skirt.
P sees it and makes her spread wide.

What did Yukiho wish for?
How will this story end?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ148737.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
雪步一如往常，被狗吓得仓皇逃跑，但今天追着她的却是一只特别的神犬。“我可以实现你一个愿望。”神犬说道。雪步许下愿望，神犬便在耀眼的光芒中消失了！连她的内裤也一起带走了！雪步裙底空空地回到家。P看到后，便让她张开双腿。

雪步许下了什么愿望？故事又将如何收场？[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ148737.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
